# Never-Miss-a-Lead

> Never-Miss-a-Lead replies in under a minute on one intake channel to start: missed calls, website forms, or after-hours messages — whichever costs you more jobs. Every lead lands in one inbox. $199 one-time setup + $99/month — $298 first month total, then $99/month, month-to-month.

Never-Miss-a-Lead is a product by Northbeam Builds, a small studio in Austin, TX that builds websites and AI tools for local service businesses. Company site: https://northbeambuilds.com

## What it is

When a customer calls and nobody picks up, or fills out a website form at 9pm, they get a reply within a minute instead of silence — and every inquiry lands in one inbox for the owner. It follows up after a missed call or message, by text; it does not answer the phone live by voice.

## Who it is for

For: local service businesses that miss calls and after-hours inquiries while out on jobs.
Not for: businesses that want a voice answering calls live (that is the AI Phone Receptionist) — Never-Miss-a-Lead follows up by text after the missed call.

## Price

$199 one-time setup + $99/month. First month total: $298. Month-to-month, no long-term contract. Cancel anytime and you owe nothing further.
Guarantee: live by the date we agree, or your setup fee comes back in full — guaranteed.
Free trial: 14 days on the website-form path — every form fill gets an instant reply by email. No card, and the trial stops on its own at day 14. Text replies are not part of the trial: they need carrier registration, which starts with the plan.
Buy online (Stripe checkout): https://buy.stripe.com/eVqdR98AY8BKgMWcfAgYU00

## How it works

1. A short setup form — about five minutes. You fill it in yourself — nothing is pre-filled; many answers are quick picks from a list: your hours, services, and where leads should go.
2. We build it; you test it on your own phone; then it goes live.
3. On the channel you start with, every inquiry gets a reply in under a minute and lands in one inbox. If a customer replies with a hard question, it is flagged to you right away.

## Questions and answers

- Q: How fast is “instant”?
  A: Under a minute, day or night.
- Q: What do I have to do?
  A: A short setup form — about five minutes. You fill it in yourself — nothing is pre-filled; many answers are quick picks from a list. It collects your hours, services, and where leads should go. We build it, you test it on your own phone, then it goes live. Text replies need a carrier registration (A2P) that takes 2–5 business days; the email path goes live right away.
- Q: What does the first month cost, in total?
  A: $298 total: the $199 one-time setup plus $99 for the first month of service. After that it's $99/month, month-to-month.
- Q: What if the customer replies with a hard question?
  A: The reply starts the conversation and captures the details. Anything real gets flagged to you right away — you take it from there.
- Q: Does it answer my phone live?
  A: No. Never-Miss-a-Lead follows up after a missed call or message, by text. If you want a voice to pick up the call itself, see the AI Phone Receptionist (https://northbeambuilds.com/tools/ai-phone-receptionist/) from Northbeam Builds.
- Q: Can I cancel?
  A: Yes. It's month-to-month. Cancel anytime and you owe nothing further.
- Q: Is there a page for plumbing shops?
  A: Yes — https://nevermiss.northbeambuilds.com/for-plumbers/ covers missed-call text-back for plumbers, what a customer gets when a call rings out on a job, and a calculator that uses the shop's own missed calls and average ticket. Same price: $199 setup + $99/month.
- Q: Is there a page for HVAC companies?
  A: Yes — https://nevermiss.northbeambuilds.com/for-hvac/ covers missed-call text-back for HVAC companies, what a customer gets when a no-heat or no-cooling call rings out while the techs are on other jobs, and a calculator that uses the company's own missed calls and average ticket. Same price: $199 setup + $99/month.
- Q: Is there a page for roofing companies?
  A: Yes — https://nevermiss.northbeambuilds.com/for-roofers/ covers missed-call text-back for roofing companies, what a customer gets when a leak or storm-damage call rings out while the crews are on roofs, and a calculator that uses the company's own missed calls and average ticket. Same price: $199 setup + $99/month.
